t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Monna O nama ko, ngo poggali no ogo para kohaddon asta nikko. Mallo-o kloni mismo ngo hago lomilomit nikko keng kollos, ngo ogo keng kaayo-ayo, hikko keng malikoddo anda ottad ngo nama, hikko na eng kotawang neng hirap eng boy-yottow neng naw-wo mo.
